page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance integrates two NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units, providing a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM to accelerate parallel computing tasks.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring reliance on external cloud storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of dual NVIDIA P4 GPUs offers an entry-level hardware acceleration profile, balancing multi-GPU compute capabilities with a moderate system memory footprint without the premium cost associated with newer-generation tensor core accelerators.

The ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is designed for workloads that benefit from GPU acceleration and multi-core processing. Suitable applications include video transcoding, entry-level deep learning inference, parallel graphics rendering, and general-purpose GPU-assisted computing tasks that do not require high-speed local storage.
